Reporting.landing_hero_audience: For committee managers, local councils, and management companies – all reports in one place, sorted and prioritized.

Reporting.landing_mgr_headline: From Chaotic WhatsApp to Organized Dashboard
Reporting.landing_mgr_bullet1: All reports consolidated in one place in real time
Reporting.landing_mgr_bullet2: Smart automated prioritization by urgency and categories
Reporting.landing_mgr_bullet3: Direct communication channel and automated status updates to reporter
Reporting.landing_mgr_bullet4: Tasks Backlog board for triaging and tracking deferred tasks by urgency & priority
Reporting.landing_channels_subtext: Tailored reporting interfaces for every resident, zero barriers, zero app installations
Reporting.landing_channel_web_desc: Scanning a QR code opens an instant mobile web form. AI auto-analyzes photos, detects issues, and submits in 15 seconds.
Reporting.landing_channel_whatsapp_desc: Report issues directly via WhatsApp conversation. Send photos, text, or voice messages—our AI chatbot opens tickets and sends automated real-time status updates.
Reporting.landing_feature_quicktap_desc: One-touch reporting. Pre-configured templates for recurring issues. Two taps and it's sent.
Reporting.landing_feature_backlog_desc: Smart task management for building committees & property managers. Triage and drag-and-drop tickets into priority columns (Urgent, Important, Backlog).
Reporting.landing_feature_interfaces_desc: Full multi-channel support: accessible Web SPA and smart WhatsApp AI chatbot for every resident.
Reporting.landing_feature_sla_desc: No report gets lost. Automated alerts for committees and residents with custom dashboard color status states.
Reporting.landing_feature_ai_desc: Smart photo detection. Snapping a photo automatically identifies the category and urgency of the maintenance issue.
Reporting.landing_feature_isolation_desc: Strict data isolation per building tenant, detailed security audit logs, and compliance with high privacy standards.
Reporting.landing_about_desc: We built TikTak out of deep frustration with chaotic community WhatsApp groups where issues and requests simply got lost. Our goal is to provide a fully automated tracking layer that handles the bureaucracy in the background, keeps public spaces functioning, and enables rapid treatment – without forcing any resident to download another useless app.
Reporting.landing_pricing_pilot_details: 1 active WhatsApp line, basic AI categorization, up to 50 active reports per month.
Reporting.landing_pricing_enterprise_details: Simultaneous integration with multiple WhatsApp lines, custom SLA alerts, multi-user management, advanced data export.
Reporting.landing_modal_success: Registration received successfully! A representative will contact you shortly to start the pilot.

Reporting.landing_faq_a1: TikTak is an automated system that allows residents to report building maintenance issues or hazards in under 15 seconds, with no app downloads or registrations required. Reporting is done quickly by scanning a dedicated QR code and sending a photo to WhatsApp.
Reporting.landing_faq_q2: What features are available for admins and end-users?
Reporting.landing_faq_a2: For end-users (residents), the system offers a rapid 'Snap & Send' flow with automated AI detection of the issue category, floor, and location—no manual typing required. For admins (building committee or management company), it provides a advanced management dashboard, real-time ticket consolidation, smart prioritization, an SLA alert engine, and automated status updates sent directly back to the reporter's WhatsApp.
Reporting.landing_faq_q3: What are the benefits of using TikTak?
Reporting.landing_faq_a3: The main benefit is eliminating reporting friction – the reporting process takes only 15 seconds, which significantly increases resident participation. Additionally, the system prevents duplicate reports, saves chat clutter in community WhatsApp groups, and enables property managers to track and resolve issues efficiently while maintaining high satisfaction rates and faster response times.
Reporting.landing_faq_q4: Is there a trial for TikTak?
Reporting.landing_faq_a4: Yes, TikTak offers a free pilot tier designed for small communities and building committees to try out the system, including one active WhatsApp line and up to 50 active reports per month. For local councils and large management companies, we offer a tailored pilot customized to their needs.

HelpGuide.title: TikTak User Guide
HelpGuide.copy_notice: * Clicking copy will generate a pre-formatted TikTak WhatsApp message
HelpGuide.step1_desc: Find and scan the QR code or click the link below. On your first report, enter your phone number to verify against the building list. The system will remember you.
HelpGuide.step2_snap: Use the red camera button. AI automatically categorizes the issue.
HelpGuide.step2_manual: For non-visual issues like noises or smells. Voice recording available inside.
HelpGuide.step2_quicktap: Report instantly with pre-set buttons in just 2 clicks.
HelpGuide.step2_bot: Authorized residents registered in the whitelist can report new maintenance issues directly inside WhatsApp. To report an issue, send "Hi" to TikTak's WhatsApp number and follow the bot prompts.
HelpGuide.step3_4_desc: Verify the location/category and click the green button. The system sends the report automatically via our backend – no need to open WhatsApp or click "Send" manually!
HelpGuide.resident_dashboard_desc: By accessing the "View previous reports" link, authorized residents can track and interact with active issues in the building:
HelpGuide.mgr_dynamic_panel: Filters update stats and charts in real-time.
HelpGuide.mgr_drag_drop: Move cards between columns to update status instantly (recorded in Audit Log).
HelpGuide.mgr_quicktap_id: These tickets are marked with a blue ⚡ QuickTap tag.
HelpGuide.mgr_backlog: Selecting "Move to Backlog" in a ticket's status dropdown (from New or In Progress) moves it to the "Tasks Backlog" tab at the top of the "Important & Urgent" column. Administrators can drag & drop tickets across 3 Eisenhower matrix columns (Important & Urgent, Important & Not Urgent, Not Important & Urgent) and reorder them by priority. Changing status back to New/In Progress/Resolved/Rejected returns the ticket to the main dashboard.
HelpGuide.mgr_forward_vendor: Click the green "Forward to Vendor" button on any ticket card to open an editable dispatch modal. Sends structured ticket details to external vendors via WhatsApp with interactive Quick Reply buttons ("Received the message" / "Done"). Vendor response status tracks in real-time inside the card button tooltip (up to 3 vendor dispatches per ticket).
HelpGuide.mgr_comments_whatsapp: Click the comment icon 💬 on any ticket card to write admin notes. Use "Save Comment" for internal storage, or "Save & Send to WhatsApp" / "Send to WhatsApp" to dispatch a formatted progress update directly to the reporter's WhatsApp.
HelpGuide.mgr_notifications_hub: Smart notifications hub (Bell icon) grouping urgent hazards, SLA breaches, duplicate report spikes, stalled vendor follow-ups, and quota alerts under 4 clear categories with unread filter and backlog counters.
HelpGuide.mgr_ticket_details_modal: Clicking the ticket description or 'View ticket' in alerts opens a comprehensive details modal displaying embedded photos, voice recordings, SLA history, and 1-click actions.
HelpGuide.mgr_ticket_analysis: Click cards to view media. Use headphones for audio.
HelpGuide.mgr_sla_desc: The system automatically calculates working days spent on each ticket from creation or status update:
HelpGuide.mgr_wa_creation: Instantly notifies the resident with a confirmation, and alerts building administrators with a high-density structured summary.
HelpGuide.mgr_wa_status: Moving a ticket to "In Progress" or marking it as "Resolved" / "Rejected" automatically triggers a professionally drafted WhatsApp update straight to the reporter's phone.
HelpGuide.mgr_bi_desc: Comprehensive analytics for tracking building health, recurring failure hotspots, contractor SLAs, and proactive recommendations:
HelpGuide.mgr_bi_export: Clicking "Export Committee Report" generates a professional, board-ready executive report for committee meetings and annual tenant assemblies in 1 click.
HelpGuide.mgr_bi_banner: Admins can pin prominent alerts directly atop the resident reporting screen from any recurring failure hotspot. Prevents duplicate submissions, supports auto-expiration (24h, 48h, 7d, manual), includes a resident close button, and provides 1-click formatted WhatsApp broadcast text.
HelpGuide.mgr_bi_funnel: Diagnoses bottlenecks across the pipeline — identifying whether delays stem from committee intake or vendor field execution.
HelpGuide.mgr_bi_workload: Tracks ticket resolution distribution across committee members to avoid single-volunteer burnout.
HelpGuide.mgr_bi_insights: Heuristic engine analyzing building metrics to provide actionable recommendations for upgrading resident service quality.
HelpGuide.mgr_bi_vendors: Objective contractor telemetry measuring dispatch volume, average response time, turnaround hours, and completion rates.
HelpGuide.mgr_settings_whitelist: The heart of the system. Manage authorized reporters. In addition to uploading a bulk CSV file, administrators can manually add, edit, or delete individual whitelist records directly within the system.
HelpGuide.mgr_settings_users: Add/Edit admin users with system access.
HelpGuide.mgr_settings_vendors: Vendors Management: Add, edit, and delete external vendors and service technicians. Saved vendors automatically link to the "Forward to Vendor" dispatch popup on ticket cards, displaying vendor names in tooltips and audit logs.
HelpGuide.mgr_settings_quicktap: Configure up to 6 pre-set buttons for common issues (QuickTap).
HelpGuide.mgr_settings_branding: Update names, labels, and data lists.
HelpGuide.privacy_media: • Media is automatically deleted after 1 year.
HelpGuide.privacy_phone: • Phone numbers are used for authentication only.
HelpGuide.privacy_security: • Data is stored securely under strict industry standards.
